entrance.subtitle: A one-day exhibition celebrating an extraordinary person.

curatorsNote.title: Curator's Note
curatorsNote.p1: "This exhibition is created to honor a resilient, independent, and ambitious girl."
curatorsNote.p2: A girl who dared to pack her bags and travel to a distant land to chase her dreams, passing through countless cities and leaving the brightest footprints of her youth. Happy 27th Birthday, Hanh Nguyen.

profile.name: Hanh Nguyen
profile.specialSkillsDesc: Surviving in a billion-people country, Wanderlust, Taming stubborn students.
profile.favoriteThingsDesc: Eat clean in the morning - feast at night, Exploring new cities, Cotti Coffee & Pastries.
profile.funFactsDesc: Set foot in 12 major Chinese cities; Used to be a tutor but was too gentle to ask for tuition fees.

traits.t1Desc: Dared to study alone in Suzhou, wandering to see seagulls in Qingdao even when it was freezing enough to get frostbite.
traits.t2Desc: Loves to play along with silly jokes, smoothly transitioning from pretending to be ChatGPT to sharing early-morning laughs.
traits.t3Desc: A gentle teacher who loves her students so much she'd rather take the loss than be harsh on them.
traits.t4Desc: Delicately notices others' intentions from the smallest details. Always offers sincere, insightful compliments and effortlessly turns any conversation into a positive, joyful experience.
traits.t5Desc: Whether sick, exhausted, or rushing across Hanoi districts, she always maintains a cheerful and positive attitude.
traits.t6Desc: Despite having 0 survival instinct against food poisoning, this girl still can't resist the temptation of sweets and milk tea.

timeline.title: Journey & Milestones
timeline.m1Story: There was a time when this girl didn't mind the exhausting rides across multiple districts in Hanoi just to teach. A gentle teacher who couldn't bear to be strict when her students were stubborn. Her dedication surely made her the 'White Moonlight' in the hearts of those kids.
timeline.m2Story: October 3, 2024, marked a brave milestone when she officially arrived at Soochow University. Leaving the familiarity of Vietnam to embrace the life of an international student, she started her independent journey in a completely strange place, handling everything herself and overcoming initial language and cultural barriers.
timeline.m3Story: In less than 2 years, this little girl has traveled and explored countless lands: Hangzhou, Shanghai, Suzhou, Beijing, Tianjin, Wuxi, Changzhou, Guangzhou, Nanjing, Qingdao, Ningbo. Whether it's the freezing cold in Qingdao to see seagulls or the bustling streets of Shanghai, every place preserves her freedom and bravery.
timeline.m4Story: Living abroad sometimes means struggling with spicy, greasy food when all you crave is boiled veggies, or enduring stomachaches and unexpected food poisoning. Yet, faced with any trouble, she is always seen handling things with a cheerful, witty attitude and a radiant smile.
